scope: Read-only production code and tests; offline fake-native integration and negative tests. No actual selection freeze, native model call, Docker runtime execution, or scientific acceptance performed in this review.

tests.command: controller-venv python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s research/benchmark/tests -p test_factory_efficiency_v4.py -v
tests.fixture_runtime_records: synthetic; positive exports use real compile_package and export_task

findings: Initial gate gap fixed: an arbitrary unrelated review blob or empty export no longer replaces a bound independent full-release semantic declaration.
Runtime binds this arm candidate output directory, exact package raw SHA256 and canonical digest. Release record binds candidate hash and runtime digest.

Compiled manifest fixed staging path, task/paper identity and candidate hash are checked. Every candidate public asset actual byte hash is rechecked; compiled public path/hash set must equal complete candidate public set.

Actual published task.json equals full compiled public projection plus exact public asset manifest and development release mode. Actual export directory and fresh scan are checked, including controller-added text, asset inventory and bytes.

Independent release report requires pass/full_actual_published_surface, explicit reviewer/findings/finite time/independence and arm result, candidate, runtime, release record, every compiled/public task identity, asset inventory digest and binary reviewed-path obligations. Changed controller text cannot inherit old report approval.
Second pair requires both first-pair arms completed and independent quality/runtime/release gate. Failed or rate-limited prior arm cannot automatically continue. Existing arm retry is refused.

All three native roles are wrapped by IdentityBoundRunner(QualityBoundRunner(native)); both arms share full policy and original private-prior identity mapping. Sentinel historical original and controller hash-fill flow are exercised by offline tests.
Missing prior review is honestly represented as missing and full-review-required, not fabricated or treated as incremental scientific review evidence.

Freeze captures all mrhbench Python modules including identity gates, prompts and active scripts; source and snapshot hashes, explicit overlays, policy/schema binding, source map and transitive case inputs are rechecked.

Run-arm ledger hard stop is baseline612+pair12=624 with maximum3 per arm. Conditional629 authorization is bound as evidence but is not a spendable run-arm cap. This driver has no prospective-run command.
negative_tests_observed: empty reviewer/findings and boolean review time
nonfinite time rejected by strict JSON writer
controller prompt changed without renewed semantic report
candidate public bytes changed after runtime
limitations: Hashes bind evidence, not truthfulness of a semantic reviewer or OS isolation. The validator explicitly returns semantic_truth_established_by_validator=false.
Final actual selection, authorization and input inventory must still pass freeze/preflight; no claim that pending draft is frozen or fresh.
Actual CPU runtime and independent complete public-surface semantic inspection remain required before second-pair gate; fixture records are not runtime acceptance.
No new model usage or real cost reduction measured. Conditional prospective allowance still requires its separately authorized quality/cost conditions and an appropriately bounded controller.
